title: EGBs: Take profit on short 10y FRA–ITA–GER credit fly

classification.rationale: The note closes a 10y ITA–FRA–GER credit fly trade for profit, which is a relative value spread trade, with the French presidential election as a forward-looking risk driver.
classification.runner_up_reason: It concerns 10y government bond spreads, but the focus is a cross-country fly trade rather than a single curve.
